question: Should OpenClaw publish and support `runIsolatedCompletion` as a trusted plugin runtime capability, including its fail-closed semantics for third-party harnesses?
rationale: The branch adds both a runtime API and public harness documentation; source review cannot determine whether maintainers want this to become a durable plugin contract or remain an internal bundled-owner seam.

options.title: Approve a supported harness contract
options.body: Accept the documented capability, define its compatibility and deprecation expectations, and require current-head proof before merge.

options.title: Keep the capability internal
options.body: Refactor the feature behind bundled runtime ownership so external harness authors do not receive a new API contract.

options.title: Pause the feature direction
options.body: Leave the PR open only if maintainers want a broader pure-inference API design discussion before implementation lands.

recommendation.title: Approve a supported harness contract
recommendation.body: Accept the documented capability, define its compatibility and deprecation expectations, and require current-head proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the strongest available technical routing candidate through the related merged Copilot auth work and the proposed runtime contract.
